sources.title: Computing probabilistic bounds for extreme eigenvalues of symmetric matrices with the Lanczos method
sources.authors: Jos L. M. van Dorsselaer, Michiel E. Hochstenbach, Henk A. van der Vorst
sources.publication: SIAM Journal on Matrix Analysis and Applications 22(3), 837-852 (2000)
sources.source_note: Repository cover describes a 1999 preprint; the included journal PDF explicitly gives 2000 and electronic publication 7 December 2000.
sources.opened_evidence: Primary paper PDF, especially abstract, introduction, section 2 rounding disclaimer, sections 3 and 5 polynomial bounds.
sources.relevance: Direct prior-art collision for randomized gap-free spectral certification and warning about small-residual misconvergence. The paper excludes rounding-error analysis.

sources.title: Estimating Extremal Eigenvalues and Condition Numbers of Matrices
sources.author: John D. Dixon
sources.relevance: Early probabilistic eigenvalue/condition estimation; not evidence that this worker invented the random-probe principle.

sources.title: Exact and efficient Lanczos method on a quantum computer
sources.authors: William Kirby, Mario Motta, Antonio Mezzacapo
sources.relevance: Efficient quantum Krylov route requires inverse-polynomial initial ground overlap; that interface is not free or acquired here. No quantum hardware claim.
